Substituting this solution and its derivatives into the ODE, collecting like terms, and setting coefficients equal to zero, we obtain:

  • a recurrence formula from the coefficients of the [MATH: n \geq 1] terms.

We are given the three terms of the ODE as power series with the [MATH: \color{blue}n=0] term isolated in each.

[MATH: 10x^{2}y^{″}|= 10(λ^{2} − λ)a_{0}x^{λ} + ∑_(n = 1)^(∞)10((λ + n)^{2} − (λ + n))a_{n}x^{λ + n},; 7xy^{′}|= 7λa_{0}x^{λ} + ∑_(n = 1)^(∞)7(λ + n)a_{n}x^{λ + n},; (3x − 1)y|= − a_{0}x^{λ} + ∑_(n = 1)^(∞)(3a_{n − 1} − a_{n})x^{λ + n}.]

Now, we continue from this point.

Step 4: Consolidate all the series into a single series that is equal to [MATH: 0.]

Collecting the terms for [MATH: {\color{blue}n=0},] we have

[MATH: 10(λ^{2} − λ)a_{0}x^{λ} + 7λa_{0}x^{λ} − a_{0}x^{λ}|=; (10λ^{2} − 10λ + 7λ − 1)a_{0}x^{λ}|=; (10λ^{2} − 3λ − 1)a_{0}x^{λ}.]

Similarly, collecting terms for [MATH: n\geq 1,] we have

[MATH: ∑_(n = 1)^(∞)[10((λ + n)^{2} − (λ + n))a_{n} + 7(λ + n)a_{n} + (3a_{n − 1} − a_{n})]x^{λ + n}|=; ∑_(n = 1)^(∞)[10(λ + n)^{2}a_{n} − 3(λ + n)a_{n} − a_{n} + 3a_{n − 1}]x^{λ + n}|=; x^{λ}∑_(n = 1)^(∞)[(10(λ + n)^{2} − 3(λ + n) − 1)a_{n} + 3a_{n − 1}]x^{n}|.]

Therefore, we obtain

[MATH: (10λ^{2} − 3λ − 1)a_{0}x^{λ} + x^{λ}∑_(n = 1)^(∞)[(10(λ + n)^{2} − 3(λ + n) − 1)a_{n} + 3a_{n − 1}]x^{n}|= 0; (10λ^{2} − 3λ − 1)a_{0} + ∑_(n = 1)^(∞)[(10(λ + n)^{2} − 3(λ + n) − 1)a_{n} + 3a_{n − 1}]x^{n}|= 0.]

Step 5: Set the coefficients of the series equal to [MATH: 0.]

Setting the coefficients of the [MATH: n=0] term equal to [MATH: 0] with arbitrary [MATH: a_0\neq0,] we obtain the indicial equation:

[MATH: (10λ^{2} − 3λ − 1)a_{0}|= 0; 10λ^{2} − 3λ − 1|= 0; (2λ − 1)(5λ + 1)|= 0; λ|= − (1)/(5), (1)/(2)]

Since we're interested in [MATH: \lambda\in(0,1),] we take [MATH: \lambda=\dfrac12.]
